Subject: Resale settlement & pass-through clause — MSA / Order Form redlines

Hi Sara / Mark,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, attached are Redwood's proposed redlines for the reseller addendum and the companion Order Form. High-level asks from our side:

- Keep indemnity allocation tied to acting party (no broad upstream pass-through without cap).
- Clarify invoicing flow: Reseller bills end-customer and Redwood invoices Reseller monthly for fulfilled usage; Reseller responsible for taxes and remittances.
- Add a limited pass-through clause for third-party marketplace fees (explicit carve-out and cap).
- Include SLA exceptions related to marketplace downtime and define fallback model routing.

Please review the attached: Redwood_Resale_Addendum_Redlines_v1.pdf and Proposed_OrderForm_3.docx. The items we expect legal to confirm or provide counter language on are bullets 2 and 3 above — those are the stopper items for Finance.

If you have an internal preferred clause for pass-through fees (for example, percentage cap or absolute cap), send it over and we can respond quickly.

I'd like to propose a short 30-minute alignment call early next week to finalize language before we escalate to the billing/finance teams. Are you available Tue or Wed morning PST?

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Channel Sales
Redwood Inference

Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft. We pushed our in-house legal team's counter redlines (attached) and added comments on the pass-through language. Main points from ResellerCo: 

- Reseller requests an explicit pass-through where Redwood accepts liability for product defects but Reseller may pass certain third-party marketplace fees and government-imposed charges to end customers.
- Proposed a 5% cap on pass-through fees related to marketplace fees and payment processor surcharges; any fees above that are to be discussed.
- Suggested an escrow arrangement for disputed settlements > $50k pending resolution to avoid billing interruptions.

We flagged section 4.2 (liability flow) where our language diverges — you'll see inline comments in Reseller_Counter_Redlines_v2.pdf.

We can do Tue 11/24 at 10:00 AM PST for the alignment call (Mark and I). If that doesn't work for your team, propose alternatives.

Best,

Subject: Re: Resale settlement & pass-through clause — MSA / Order Form redlines

Kim / Laura / Sara,

Thanks for the counter. I pulled legal and finance notes — here's a concise proposal intended as a middle ground so Finance can approve without an escrow hold-up: 

1) Pass-through carve-out: allow Reseller to pass through third-party marketplace fees and payment processor surcharges but only for items that Redwood can validate via invoice from the third party.
2) Cap mechanics: adopt a dual cap — 5% relative cap OR $25k absolute cap per monthly invoice item (whichever is lower). That keeps runaway exposure bounded.
3) Escrow: instead of full escrow for disputes, we propose a reserve withholding on the disputed portion with an automatic 30-day dispute resolution timeline; if unresolved, escalate to senior legal sign-off with payment hold limited to the disputed amount.
4) Indemnity: Redwood remains primary indemnitor for defects; Reseller indemnifies for end-customer misuse and mis-billing. Limit of liability tied to aggregate fees paid under the specific Order Form (not company-wide).

If ResellerCo accepts the dual cap + reserve withholding construct, Finance can accept the flow and we can move to signature.

I am pasting Sara's earlier note inline for context:
